summary: Tested the one-line TUTOR_SYSTEM prompt change (conciseness cap 'maximum of 5 sentences total') via POST /api/tutor/chat. Verified in EN and DE: replies are genuinely short (4 main sentences + 1 appended disclaimer sentence = 5 total, well within the new cap, a clear improvement over old multi-paragraph style). follow_up_questions array still returned correctly (0-3 items). Advice-refusal behavior unaffected (empty follow_up_questions, no ticker recommendation). No-Markdown rule holds. Inline parenthetical jargon definitions still present (e.g. 'stock means a tiny piece of ownership...', 'Aktionäre (Menschen, die Aktien besitzen...)'). All 6 new test cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Change was minimal and surgical (one line in TUTOR_SYSTEM); no side effects observed in tutor_chat/append_disclaimer/is_advice_seeking logic.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_concise_<uuid>@example.com user via signup for auth; no persistent seed data required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Tutor conciseness change confirmed working well - replies in EN/DE observed at 4 main sentences + disclaimer, well under old verbose style. follow_up_questions, no-markdown, inline jargon definitions, and advice-refusal logic all unaffected and passing. Reusable test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_41_tutor_conciseness.py for future regression (note: BASE_URL env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL must be exported from frontend/.env manually before running pytest since it's not in shell env by default).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bug found, change verified working as intended.
